QuestInfo.name: [Ariant] A New Day in Ariant
QuestInfo.1: The people of Ariant are happy that Areda has been chased out. Sirin the dancer decides to perform before the people and the Sultan. Schegerazade invites the Sand Bandits' trusted collaborators to join in.
QuestInfo.2: Peace returned to Ariant thanks to the efforts of the Alliance and Sand Bandits. The people of Ariant enjoyed Sirin's performance and laughed with hearts finally unburdened by tyranny.
QuestInfo.0: Areda is chased out, and peace returns to Ariant. Schegerazade, who is released from prison, sends you a special invitation...
